```{r}

library(odbc)
library(DBI)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx2)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
library(bizdays)
library(janitor)

con <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),
               Driver   = "*****",
                 Server   = "*****",
                 Database = "*****",
                 UID = "*****",
                 PWD = "*****",
                 Port = *****)

Validation  <- tbl(con, DBI::Id(schema = "SME", table = "Holiday")) %>% collect()
BD_Calender <- create.calendar(name = "BD", holidays = Validation$Date, weekdays = c("friday", "saturday"))

last_working_day  <- as.Date(bizdays::add.bizdays(Sys.Date(), -1, "BD"))
prior_working_day <- as.Date(bizdays::add.bizdays(Sys.Date(), -2, "BD"))
window_start_day  <- as.Date(last_working_day - months(3))

window_start <- paste0(window_start_day)
window_end   <- paste0(last_working_day)
yday         <- as.character(last_working_day)

output_dir     <- "~/Report/Daily/Projection Report"
output_file    <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("Projection_for_", last_working_day, ".xlsx"))
yesterday_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("Projection_for_", prior_working_day, ".xlsx"))

```

```{r}
  "Mohammed Omar Faruque"     = "omarf"
)

#RCM display order -- order of first appearance in branch_mapping
rcm_order <- unique(branch_mapping$RCM)

#Branch -> HoRB mapping, sourced from sme.RBH. Joined into every lead-wise detail tab
#(added after the STM column) -- not used in the summary/dashboard tables.
HoRB_mapping <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT Branch, RBH AS HoRB FROM sme.RBH")

excluded_branches     <- c("Uttara", "Dhanmondi")
excluded_branches_sql <- paste0("'", excluded_branches, "'", collapse = ", ")

excluded_rejection_reasons <- c(
 
  "From credit end: Sufficient Documents not submitted as per the STP policy.",
  "Rejected Due to Delayed Negotiation"
)



excluded_rejection_sql <- paste0("'", excluded_rejection_reasons, "'", collapse = ", ")

#STP definition -- now sourced from dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2, matched to dbo.AnalyticsOCAS by
#LeadReferenceNo. FileCategory in AnalyticsOCASV2 ('STP' / otherwise) is used directly.
#A lead with no match in AnalyticsOCASV2 is left out entirely (INNER JOIN), so it never
#appears in any of the pulls below.
stp_join_sql <- "INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2 ON dbo.AnalyticsOCAS.LeadReferenceNo = dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.LeadReferenceNo"

#If FileCategory in AnalyticsOCASV2 is blank/NULL for a matched lead, treat it as Non-STP
#(rather than dropping it -- only a missing LeadReferenceNo match drops the lead, via the
#INNER JOIN above).
file_category_sql <- "CASE WHEN dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.FileCategory = 'STP' THEN 'STP' ELSE 'Non-STP' END"

```

```{r}

#To Be Visited
#NOTE: window is now anchored to Lead_Approver_Date (lead creation date), same 3-month
#trailing window used everywhere else, matching Script 2's approach. Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest
#is no longer date-range filtered -- it is only checked for non-null (the lead has reached
#this stage), so a lead created within the window still shows up here regardless of how
#recent/old its own stage date is.

to_be_visited_leads <- dbGetQuery(con,paste0("SELECT Branch,dbo.AnalyticsOCAS.LeadReferenceNo LeadReferenceNo,ProspectName,Interested_Amount_To,Interested_Amount_To/1E6 Interested_Amount_To_Mln,
[Business Type],CRG_Applicability,Product_Category,LOWER(Analyst_Name) Analyst_Name,[Credit Analyst] as Credit_Analyst,RM_Name,STM_Name, 
CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) Lead_Approver_Date,
CAST(Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest AS DATE) Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
", file_category_sql, " File_Category
FROM dbo.AnalyticsOCAS
", stp_join_sql, "
WHERE Branch NOT IN (", excluded_branches_sql, ")
AND Product_Category = 'SME'
AND Lead_Approver_Date BETWEEN '", window_start, "' AND '", window_end, "'
AND Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND CRM_Visit_Date IS NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest IS NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest IS NULL
AND Sanction_Date_Initial IS NULL
AND (Reject_Date IS NULL OR Reject_Date = '1900-01-01')")) |>
 mutate(
    Credit_Analyst = ifelse(is.na(Credit_Analyst) | trimws(Credit_Analyst) == "","Unassigned", Credit_Analyst),
    File_Category = ifelse(is.na(File_Category) | trimws(File_Category) == "","Non-STP", File_Category)) |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch") |>
  left_join(HoRB_mapping, by = "Branch")

to_be_visited_summary <- to_be_visited_leads |>
  group_by(Branch) |>
  summarise(`To Be Visited Number` = n(), `To Be Visited Amount` = sum(Interested_Amount_To_Mln)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch")

#Lead-wise detail -- exact column naming/order requested for the "To Be Visited" tab
to_be_visited_detail <- to_be_visited_leads |>
  transmute(
    `Lead Reference No` = LeadReferenceNo,
    Branch,
    Client               = ProspectName,
    `Proposed Amount`    = Interested_Amount_To,
    `File Category`      = File_Category,
    `CRG `       = CRG_Applicability,
    `Lead Creation Date` = Lead_Approver_Date,
    `Prospect Completion Date`    = Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
    Analyst              = Credit_Analyst,
    CM,
    RCM,
    RM                   = RM_Name,
    STM                  = STM_Name,
    HoRB
  )

```

```{r}

#Decision To Be Made -- STP leads pulled separately, then Non-STP leads, then stacked with rbind
#(same pattern as the analyst script's Approved + Reopen pull)
#Window anchored to Lead_Approver_Date; every intermediate stage date is only checked for non-null.

decision_stp_leads <- dbGetQuery(con,paste0("SELECT Branch,dbo.AnalyticsOCAS.LeadReferenceNo LeadReferenceNo,ProspectName,Interested_Amount_To,Interested_Amount_To/1E6 Interested_Amount_To_Mln,
[Business Type],CRG_Applicability,LOWER(Analyst_Name) Analyst_Name,[Credit Analyst] as Credit_Analyst,RM_Name,STM_Name,
CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) Lead_Approver_Date,
CAST(Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest AS DATE) Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
CAST(CRM_Visit_Date AS DATE) CRM_Visit_Date,
CAST(Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest AS DATE) Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
CAST(Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest AS DATE) Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest,
dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.RequestDelayReason RequestDelayReason,
dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.AnalystRemark AnalystRemark
FROM dbo.AnalyticsOCAS
", stp_join_sql, "
WHERE Branch NOT IN (", excluded_branches_sql, ")
AND Product_Category = 'SME'
AND ", file_category_sql, " = 'STP'
AND Lead_Approver_Date BETWEEN '", window_start, "' AND '", window_end, "'
AND Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND CRM_Visit_Date IS NOT NULL
AND Sanction_Date_Initial IS NULL
AND (Reject_Date IS NULL OR Reject_Date = '1900-01-01')")) |>
  mutate(File_Category  = "STP",
         
         Credit_Analyst = ifelse(is.na(Credit_Analyst) | trimws(Credit_Analyst) == "","Unassigned", Credit_Analyst))

decision_non_stp_leads <- dbGetQuery(con,paste0("SELECT Branch,dbo.AnalyticsOCAS.LeadReferenceNo LeadReferenceNo,ProspectName,Interested_Amount_To,Interested_Amount_To/1E6 Interested_Amount_To_Mln,
[Business Type],CRG_Applicability,LOWER(Analyst_Name) Analyst_Name,[Credit Analyst] as Credit_Analyst,RM_Name,STM_Name,
CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) Lead_Approver_Date,
CAST(Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest AS DATE) Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
CAST(CRM_Visit_Date AS DATE) CRM_Visit_Date,
CAST(Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest AS DATE) Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
CAST(Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest AS DATE) Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest,
dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.RequestDelayReason RequestDelayReason,
dbo.AnalyticsOCASV2.AnalystRemark AnalystRemark
FROM dbo.AnalyticsOCAS
", stp_join_sql, "
WHERE Branch NOT IN (", excluded_branches_sql, ")
AND Product_Category = 'SME'
AND ", file_category_sql, " = 'Non-STP'
AND Lead_Approver_Date BETWEEN '", window_start, "' AND '", window_end, "'
AND Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND CRM_Visit_Date IS NOT NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND Sanction_Date_Initial IS NULL
AND (Reject_Date IS NULL OR Reject_Date = '1900-01-01')")) |>
  mutate(File_Category  = "Non-STP",
         
         Credit_Analyst = ifelse(is.na(Credit_Analyst) | trimws(Credit_Analyst) == "","Unassigned", Credit_Analyst))

decision_to_be_made_leads <- rbind(decision_stp_leads, decision_non_stp_leads) |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch") |>
  left_join(HoRB_mapping, by = "Branch")

decision_to_be_made_summary <- decision_to_be_made_leads |>
  group_by(Branch) |>
  summarise(`Decision To Be Made Number` = n(), `Decision To Be Made Amount` = sum(Interested_Amount_To_Mln)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch")

#Lead-wise detail -- exact column naming/order requested for the "Decision To Be Made" tab
decision_to_be_made_detail <- decision_to_be_made_leads |>
  transmute(
    `Lead Reference No` = LeadReferenceNo,
    Branch,
    Client                     = ProspectName,
    `Proposed Amount`          = Interested_Amount_To,
    `File Category`            = File_Category,
    `CRG `       = CRG_Applicability,
    `Lead Creation Date`       = Lead_Approver_Date,
    `Prospect Completion Date`    = Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
    `Analyst Visit Date`       = CRM_Visit_Date,
    `Pending Declaration Date` = Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
    `Pending Collection Date`  = Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest,
    `Delayed Processing Reason`  = RequestDelayReason,
    `Delayed Processing Remarks` = AnalystRemark,
    Analyst                    = Credit_Analyst,
    CM,
    RCM,
    RM                         = RM_Name,
    STM                        = STM_Name,
    HoRB
  )

#Delayed Processing -- same leads as "Decision To Be Made" above (same STP/Non-STP pulls,
#same stage logic), further restricted to leads that haven't moved since last_working_day:
#for STP leads, Analyst Visit Date (CRM_Visit_Date) is not last_working_day; for Non-STP
#leads, Pending Collection Date (Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest) is not
#last_working_day. Same column set/order as the "Decision To Be Made" tab.

delayed_processing_leads <- decision_to_be_made_leads |>
  filter(
    (File_Category == "STP"     & CRM_Visit_Date != last_working_day) |
    (File_Category == "Non-STP" & Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest != last_working_day)
  )

#Lead-wise detail -- same column naming/order as the "Decision To Be Made" tab
delayed_processing_detail <- delayed_processing_leads |>
  transmute(
    `Lead Reference No` = LeadReferenceNo,
    Branch,
    Client                     = ProspectName,
    `Proposed Amount`          = Interested_Amount_To,
    `File Category`            = File_Category,
    `CRG `       = CRG_Applicability,
    `Lead Creation Date`       = Lead_Approver_Date,
    `Prospect Completion Date`    = Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
    `Analyst Visit Date`       = CRM_Visit_Date,
    `Pending Declaration Date` = Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
    `Pending Collection Date`  = Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest,
    `Delayed Processing Reason`  = RequestDelayReason,
    `Delayed Processing Remarks` = AnalystRemark,
    Analyst                    = Credit_Analyst,
    CM,
    RCM,
    RM                         = RM_Name,
    STM                        = STM_Name,
    HoRB
  )

```

```{r}

#Pending Declared But Not Collected -- Non-STP leads that have been declared but not yet

[Business Type],CRG_Applicability,LOWER(Analyst_Name) Analyst_Name,[Credit Analyst] as Credit_Analyst,RM_Name,STM_Name,
CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) Lead_Approver_Date,
CAST(Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest AS DATE) Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
CAST(CRM_Visit_Date AS DATE) CRM_Visit_Date,
CAST(Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest AS DATE) Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
", file_category_sql, " File_Category
FROM dbo.AnalyticsOCAS
", stp_join_sql, "
WHERE Branch NOT IN (", excluded_branches_sql, ")
AND Product_Category = 'SME'
AND ", file_category_sql, " = 'Non-STP'
AND Lead_Approver_Date BETWEEN '", window_start, "' AND '", window_end, "'
AND Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND CRM_Visit_Date IS NOT NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest IS NOT NULL
AND Analyst_Pending_Collection_Date_Latest IS NULL
AND Sanction_Date_Initial IS NULL
AND (Reject_Date IS NULL OR Reject_Date = '1900-01-01')")) |>
  mutate(
    Credit_Analyst = ifelse(is.na(Credit_Analyst) | trimws(Credit_Analyst) == "","Unassigned", Credit_Analyst),
    File_Category = ifelse(is.na(File_Category) | trimws(File_Category) == "","Non-STP", File_Category)
  ) |>

pending_declared_not_collected_summary <- pending_declared_not_collected_leads |>

    `CRG `                     = CRG_Applicability,

    `Prospect Completion Date` = Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest,
    `Analyst Visit Date`       = CRM_Visit_Date,
    `Pending Declaration Date` = Analyst_Pending_Declaration_date_Latest,
    Analyst                    = Credit_Analyst,
    CM,
    RCM,
    RM                         = RM_Name,
    STM                        = STM_Name,
    HoRB
  )
```

```{r}

#Waiting for Prospect Creation -- leads whose Lead Creation Date (Lead_Approver_Date, date
#only, no time component) falls in the trailing-90-day window (window_start_day through
#last_working_day), but which have not yet reached Prospect Approve stage.
#(Already anchored to Lead_Approver_Date -- unchanged.)
#NOTE: this tab was previously named "Waiting for Lead Creation" -- renamed to "Waiting
#for Prospect Creation". File Category and CRG are now pulled in as well (via the same
#STP join/logic used by every other tab), since this tab didn't carry them before.

waiting_for_lead_creation_leads <- dbGetQuery(con,paste0("SELECT Branch,dbo.AnalyticsOCAS.LeadReferenceNo LeadReferenceNo,ProspectName,Interested_Amount_To,Interested_Amount_To/1E6 Interested_Amount_To_Mln,
[Business Type],CRG_Applicability,RM_Name,STM_Name,
CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) Lead_Approver_Date,
", file_category_sql, " File_Category
FROM dbo.AnalyticsOCAS
", stp_join_sql, "
WHERE Branch NOT IN (", excluded_branches_sql, ")
AND Product_Category = 'SME'
AND CAST(Lead_Approver_Date AS DATE) BETWEEN '", window_start_day, "' AND '", last_working_day, "'
AND Prospect_Approve_Date_Latest IS NULL")) |>
  mutate(File_Category = ifelse(is.na(File_Category) | trimws(File_Category) == "","Non-STP", File_Category)) |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch") |>
  left_join(HoRB_mapping, by = "Branch")

waiting_for_lead_creation_summary <- waiting_for_lead_creation_leads |>
  group_by(Branch) |>
  summarise(`Waiting for Lead Creation Number` = n(), `Waiting for Lead Creation Amount` = sum(Interested_Amount_To_Mln)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  left_join(branch_mapping, by = "Branch")
```

```{r}

#RCM-wise re-cut of the dashboard (used for "Today's Projection").
#Each RCM's branches are grouped together (RCM label shown once per group, blank for the
#remaining branch rows of that RCM so it reads as a merged cell), followed by a Sub-total
#row for that RCM, with a final grand Total row at the bottom.

metric_cols <- c(
  "To Be Visited Number", "To Be Visited Amount",
  "Pending To Be Declared Number", "Pending To Be Declared Amount",
  "Decision To Be Made Number", "Decision To Be Made Amount",
  "Yesterday_To Be Visited Number", "Yesterday_To Be Visited Amount",
  "Visited Number", "Visited Amount",
  "Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Number", "Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Amount",
  "Pending Declared Number", "Pending Declared Amount",
  "Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Number", "Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Amount",
  "Decision Finalized Number", "Decision Finalized Amount"
)

build_rcm_dashboard <- function(df, metric_cols, rcm_order, nickname_map) {

  df <- df |>
    mutate(RCM = factor(RCM, levels = rcm_order)) |>
    arrange(RCM, Branch)

  group_blocks <- lapply(rcm_order, function(rcm_name) {
    grp <- df |> filter(RCM == rcm_name)
    if (nrow(grp) == 0) return(NULL)

    branch_rows <- grp |>
      mutate(
        RCM_Display = c(unname(nickname_map[rcm_name]), rep(NA_character_, dplyr::n() - 1)),
        Row_Type    = "Branch"
      ) |>
      select(RCM_Display, Branch, Row_Type, all_of(metric_cols)) |>
      mutate(Group = rcm_name)

    subtotal_row <- grp |>
      summarise(across(all_of(metric_cols), sum)) |>
      mutate(RCM_Display = NA_character_, Branch = "Sub-total", Row_Type = "Subtotal", Group = rcm_name) |>
      select(RCM_Display, Branch, Row_Type, Group, all_of(metric_cols))

    bind_rows(branch_rows, subtotal_row)
  })

  result <- bind_rows(group_blocks)

  total_row <- df |>
    summarise(across(all_of(metric_cols), sum)) |>
    mutate(RCM_Display = NA_character_, Branch = "Total", Row_Type = "Total", Group = NA_character_) |>
    select(RCM_Display, Branch, Row_Type, Group, all_of(metric_cols))

  bind_rows(result, total_row)
}

rcm_dashboard_df <- build_rcm_dashboard(dashboard_df, metric_cols, rcm_order, rcm_nickname_map)
```

```{r}
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UPDATED:
#  1) header_color is now passed in as "#E84A45" from the call site below,
#     and is used for BOTH the header (spanner/column-label/stubhead) AND
#     the Grand Total row -- see the Grand Total tab_style block near the
#     bottom of this function.
#  2) Sub-total and Grand Total row text is now explicitly center-aligned
#     (align = "center" added to their cell_text() calls), matching the
#     Yesterday's Projection table's Sub-total/Total alignment.
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_projection_gt <- function(df, spanner_defs, top_label, top_id, header_color, rcm_color, table_width) {

  metric_cols_tbl <- unlist(lapply(spanner_defs, `[[`, "columns"), use.names = FALSE)
  number_cols_tbl <- metric_cols_tbl[grepl("Number$", metric_cols_tbl)]
  amount_cols_tbl <- metric_cols_tbl[grepl("Amount$", metric_cols_tbl)]
  spanner_ids     <- vapply(spanner_defs, `[[`, character(1), "id")

  label_list <- as.list(setNames(rep(c("Number", "Amount(Mln)"), length(metric_cols_tbl) / 2), metric_cols_tbl))

  gt_tbl <- df |>
    select(RCM_Nickname, Branch, all_of(metric_cols_tbl)) |>
    gt(groupname_col = "RCM_Nickname") |>
    tab_options(row_group.as_column = TRUE) |>
    row_group_order(groups = nickname_order) |>
    tab_stubhead(label = "RCM") |>
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.style    = "solid",
      table.border.top.width    = px(2),
      table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(2)
    ) |>
    opt_table_font(font = "IDLC") |>
    tab_options(
      table.width  = table_width,
      data_row.padding = px(3),
      table.font.size  = px(13),
      row_group.font.weight = "bold",
      row.striping.include_table_body = FALSE
    ) |>
    cols_width(Branch ~ px(150)) |>
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(number_cols_tbl), decimals = 0) |>
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(amount_cols_tbl), decimals = 2) |>
    cols_label(Branch = "Branch", .list = label_list)

  #-- one spanner per stage
  for (s in spanner_defs) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> tab_spanner(label = s$label, id = s$id, columns = all_of(s$columns))
  }

  #-- (outer top_id spanner intentionally NOT added -- see NOTE above the function.
  #   top_label/top_id are still accepted as arguments for backward compatibility with
  #   the call sites below, they're just unused now.)

  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    summary_rows(
      groups = everything(), columns = all_of(number_cols_tbl),
      fns = list(`Sub-total` = ~sum(., na.rm = TRUE)), formatter = fmt_integer, use_seps = TRUE
    ) |>
    summary_rows(
      groups = everything(), columns = all_of(amount_cols_tbl),
      fns = list(`Sub-total` = ~sum(., na.rm = TRUE)), formatter = fmt_number, decimals = 2
    ) |>
    grand_summary_rows(
      columns = all_of(number_cols_tbl),
      fns = list(`Total` = ~sum(., na.rm = TRUE)), formatter = fmt_integer, use_seps = TRUE
    ) |>
    grand_summary_rows(
      columns = all_of(amount_cols_tbl),
      fns = list(`Total` = ~sum(., na.rm = TRUE)), formatter = fmt_number, decimals = 2
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(font = "IDLC", color = "black", align = "center", weight = "normal", v_align = "middle", size = px(13)),
      locations = cells_body()
    ) |>
    #-- Header: RCM (stubhead) + Branch + every column label -> header_color
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(font = "IDLC", color = "white", align = "center", weight = "bold", v_align = "middle", size = px(13)),
        cell_fill(color = header_color)
      ),
      locations = list(
        cells_stubhead(),
        cells_column_labels(columns = c(Branch, all_of(metric_cols_tbl)))
      )
    ) |>
    #-- Branch column body cells (normal data rows) -> rcm_color, black NOT bold text
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = rcm_color), cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "normal", color = "black", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_body(columns = Branch)
    )
    #-- (top-level spanner tab_style block removed along with the outer spanner)

  #-- one tab_style call per stage spanner id (gt only reliably repaints every id in the
  #list when each gets its own call -- see note in the original combined-table version)
  for (s in spanner_defs) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_text(font = "IDLC", color = "white", weight = "bold", size = px(13)), cell_fill(color = header_color)),
        locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = s$id)
      ) |>
      #-- that stage's Number/Amount body cells -> its own colour, black NOT bold text
      #(To Be Visited = green, Pending To Be Declared = orange, Decision To Be Made = blue)
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_fill(color = s$color), cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "normal", color = "black", size = px(13))),
        locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(s$columns))
      )
  }

  gt_tbl |>
    #-- RCM group-label cells (the real merged column, one cell per RCM spanning its
    #branches) -> rcm_color, black NOT bold text -- this colour never changes, including
    #on Sub-total/Total rows, matching the reference workbook (the RCM cell is just the
    #merged continuation of the group label there)
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = rcm_color),
        cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "normal", color = "black", v_align = "middle", size = px(13))
      ),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) |>
    #-- Sub-total rows: Branch + every metric cell -> rcm_color, black BOLD text, CENTER
    #aligned (stage colours disappear here, matching the reference workbook)
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = rcm_color),
        cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "bold", color = "black", align = "center", size = px(13))
      ),
      locations = list(cells_summary(), cells_stub_summary())
    ) |>
    #-- Grand Total row: header_color fill (same accent as the header, per updated
    #requirement), bold black text, CENTER aligned
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = header_color),
        cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "bold", color = "white", align = "center", size = px(13))
      ),
      locations = list(cells_grand_summary(), cells_stub_grand_summary())
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), color = "gray", weight = px(1))),
      locations = list(cells_body(), cells_stub(), cells_row_groups(), cells_summary(), cells_stub_summary(),
                        cells_grand_summary(), cells_stub_grand_summary())
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), color = "black", weight = px(1.5))),
      locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_stubhead())
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), color = "black", weight = px(1.5))),
      locations = cells_column_spanners()
    )
}
```

```{r}
yday_metric_cols <- c(
  "Yesterday_To Be Visited Number", "Yesterday_To Be Visited Amount",
  "Visited Number", "Visited Amount",
  "Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Number", "Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Amount",
  "Pending Declared Number", "Pending Declared Amount",
  "Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Number", "Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Amount",
  "Decision Finalized Number", "Decision Finalized Amount"
)

#-- Sum branch-level metrics up to CM level, within each RCM
dashboard_cm_raw <- dashboard_df |>
  left_join(branch_mapping |> select(Branch, CM), by = "Branch") |>
  group_by(RCM, CM) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(yday_metric_cols), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

#-- CM display order within each RCM = order of first appearance in branch_mapping
cm_seq <- branch_mapping |>
  distinct(RCM, CM) |>
  mutate(seq_id = row_number())

build_rcm_cm_dashboard <- function(df, metric_cols, rcm_order, rcm_nickname_map, cm_nickname_map, cm_seq) {

  df <- df |>
    left_join(cm_seq, by = c("RCM", "CM")) |>
    mutate(RCM = factor(RCM, levels = rcm_order)) |>
    arrange(RCM, seq_id)

  group_blocks <- lapply(rcm_order, function(rcm_name) {
    grp <- df |> filter(RCM == rcm_name)
    if (nrow(grp) == 0) return(NULL)

    cm_rows <- grp |>
      mutate(
        RCM_Display = unname(rcm_nickname_map[rcm_name]),
        CM_Display  = unname(cm_nickname_map[CM]),
        Row_Type    = "CM"
      ) |>
      select(RCM_Display, CM_Display, Row_Type, all_of(metric_cols)) |>
      mutate(Group = rcm_name)

    subtotal_row <- grp |>
      summarise(across(all_of(metric_cols), sum)) |>
      mutate(RCM_Display = unname(rcm_nickname_map[rcm_name]), CM_Display = "Sub-total",
             Row_Type = "Subtotal", Group = rcm_name) |>
      select(RCM_Display, CM_Display, Row_Type, Group, all_of(metric_cols))

    bind_rows(cm_rows, subtotal_row)
  })

  result <- bind_rows(group_blocks)

  total_row <- df |>
    summarise(across(all_of(metric_cols), sum)) |>
    #-- CM_Display intentionally left BLANK ("") for the grand Total row: RCM_Display =
    #"Total" already becomes its own row-group label (shown once, in the RCM/group
    #column), so also writing "Total" into CM_Display would print the word a second
    #time in the very next cell of the same row.
    mutate(RCM_Display = "Total", CM_Display = "", Row_Type = "Total", Group = NA_character_) |>
    select(RCM_Display, CM_Display, Row_Type, Group, all_of(metric_cols))

  bind_rows(result, total_row)
}

rcm_cm_dashboard_df <- build_rcm_cm_dashboard(
  dashboard_cm_raw, yday_metric_cols, rcm_order, rcm_nickname_map, cm_nickname_map, cm_seq
)

#-- Achievement ratios (NA when the planned/denominator figure is 0, shown as "-" in the table)
safe_ratio <- function(num, den) ifelse(is.na(den) | den == 0, NA_real_, num / den)

rcm_cm_dashboard_df <- rcm_cm_dashboard_df |>
  mutate(
    `Achievement1 Number` = safe_ratio(`Visited Number`,            `Yesterday_To Be Visited Number`),
    `Achievement1 Amount` = safe_ratio(`Visited Amount`,            `Yesterday_To Be Visited Amount`),
    `Achievement2 Number` = safe_ratio(`Pending Declared Number`,   `Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Number`),
    `Achievement2 Amount` = safe_ratio(`Pending Declared Amount`,   `Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Amount`),
    `Achievement3 Number` = safe_ratio(`Decision Finalized Number`, `Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Number`),
    `Achievement3 Amount` = safe_ratio(`Decision Finalized Amount`, `Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Amount`)
  )

#-- Spanner definitions in the requested column order. `role` tags which of the three
#colour bands a spanner belongs to -- colour is now assigned BY ROLE (what the pair
#represents), reused across all three stages, matching the reference workbook:
#   role "planned"     -> green  (Yesterday_* "to-be" columns: To Be Visited / Pending
#                          To Be Declared / Decision To Be Made)
#   role "actual"      -> orange (what actually happened: Visited / Pending Declared /
#                          Decision Finalized)
#   role "achievement" -> blue   (the actual-vs-planned % columns)
yday_cm_spanner_defs <- list(
  list(label = "To Be Visited",          id = "tbv_yday",   columns = c("Yesterday_To Be Visited Number", "Yesterday_To Be Visited Amount"),         pct = FALSE, role = "planned"),
  list(label = "Visited",                id = "vis_yday",   columns = c("Visited Number", "Visited Amount"),                                          pct = FALSE, role = "actual"),
  list(label = "Achievement",            id = "achv1_yday", columns = c("Achievement1 Number", "Achievement1 Amount"),                                 pct = TRUE,  role = "achievement"),
  list(label = "Pending To Be Declared", id = "ptbd_yday",  columns = c("Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Number", "Yesterday_Pending To Be Declared Amount"), pct = FALSE, role = "planned"),
  list(label = "Pending Declared",       id = "pdec_yday",  columns = c("Pending Declared Number", "Pending Declared Amount"),                          pct = FALSE, role = "actual"),
  list(label = "Achievement",            id = "achv2_yday", columns = c("Achievement2 Number", "Achievement2 Amount"),                                 pct = TRUE,  role = "achievement"),
  list(label = "Decision To Be Made",    id = "dtbm_yday",  columns = c("Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Number", "Yesterday_Decision To Be Made Amount"), pct = FALSE, role = "planned"),
  list(label = "Decision Finalized",     id = "dfin_yday",  columns = c("Decision Finalized Number", "Decision Finalized Amount"),                      pct = FALSE, role = "actual"),
  list(label = "Achievement",            id = "achv3_yday", columns = c("Achievement3 Number", "Achievement3 Amount"),                                 pct = TRUE,  role = "achievement")
)

#-- Body-cell colour per role (light bands, matched to the reference workbook: green =
#planned, orange = actual, blue = achievement %). RCM/CM stub columns, Sub-total rows,
#and the header/title/spanner rows use their own accent colours -- set below.
yday_role_colors     <- c(planned = "#E2F0D9", actual = "#FBE5D6", achievement = "#DAE3F3")
yday_stub_color      <- "#D7DFDF"   # RCM/CM stub columns (all data rows) + Sub-total row band
yday_header_color    <- "#E84A45"   # Title row + spanner header row + column-label row
yday_total_color     <- "#E84A45"   # Grand Total row (bold, same accent as header)
```

**Yesterday's Projection**

```{r}

#Builds the RCM/CM-wise "Yesterday's Projection" gt table.
#Colour scheme (matches the reference workbook):
#  - Title/spanner/column-label rows       -> yday_header_color (#E84A45), white bold text
#  - RCM/CM stub columns (every data row)  -> yday_stub_color   (#D7DFDF), black bold text
#  - Metric body cells, by role            -> yday_role_colors  (green/orange/blue), black bold text
#  - Sub-total rows (entire row)           -> yday_stub_color   (#D7DFDF), black bold text
#  - Grand Total row (entire row, last)    -> yday_total_color  (#E84A45), white bold text
#"Total" is written into RCM_Display only (it becomes the row-group label); CM_Display is
#left blank for that row so the word "Total" is not rendered twice on the same line.

build_cm_projection_gt <- function(df, spanner_defs, role_colors, stub_color, header_color, total_color, table_width) {

  metric_cols_tbl <- unlist(lapply(spanner_defs, `[[`, "columns"), use.names = FALSE)
  pct_cols_tbl    <- unlist(lapply(spanner_defs, function(s) if (s$pct) s$columns else NULL))
  cnt_cols_tbl    <- setdiff(metric_cols_tbl, pct_cols_tbl)
  number_cnt_cols <- cnt_cols_tbl[grepl("Number$", cnt_cols_tbl)]
  amount_cnt_cols <- cnt_cols_tbl[grepl("Amount$", cnt_cols_tbl)]

  label_list <- setNames(as.list(rep(c("Number", "Amount(Mln)"), length(metric_cols_tbl) / 2)), metric_cols_tbl)
  #-- merge CM_Display's label into the same list rather than passing it as a separate
  #named argument alongside .list -- gt's cols_label() does not reliably combine a named
  #dot-argument with .list in the same call, which was causing the header to fall back
  #to the raw column name ("CM_Display") instead of the intended label ("CM").
  label_list <- c(list(CM_Display = "CM"), label_list)

  rcm_levels <- unique(df$RCM_Display[df$Row_Type != "Total"])

  gt_tbl <- df |>
    select(RCM_Display, CM_Display, all_of(metric_cols_tbl)) |>
    gt(groupname_col = "RCM_Display") |>
    tab_options(row_group.as_column = TRUE) |>
    row_group_order(groups = rcm_levels) |>
    tab_stubhead(label = "RCM") |>
    opt_table_font(font = "IDLC") |>
    tab_options(
      table.width = table_width,
      data_row.padding = px(3),
      table.font.size = px(13),
      row_group.font.weight = "bold",
      table.border.top.style = "solid", table.border.top.width = px(2),
      table.border.bottom.style = "solid", table.border.bottom.width = px(2)
    ) |>
    cols_width(CM_Display ~ px(120)) |>
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(number_cnt_cols), decimals = 0) |>
    fmt_number(columns = all_of(amount_cnt_cols), decimals = 2) |>
    fmt_percent(columns = all_of(pct_cols_tbl), decimals = 1) |>
    sub_missing(columns = all_of(pct_cols_tbl), missing_text = "-") |>
    cols_label(.list = label_list)

  for (s in spanner_defs) gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |> tab_spanner(label = s$label, id = s$id, columns = all_of(s$columns))

  subtotal_rows <- which(df$Row_Type == "Subtotal")
  total_rows    <- which(df$Row_Type == "Total")

  #-- Base text style for every body cell (colour bands applied on top of this)
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(font = "IDLC", color = "black", align = "center", weight = "bold", v_align = "middle", size = px(13)),
      locations = cells_body()
    )

  #-- Title/spanner/column-label header cells -> header_color, white bold text
  #(stubhead "RCM" label, "CM" column label, and every stage/Achievement spanner +
  #Number/Amount(Mln) column label all share the one header accent colour now.)
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold", size = px(13)), cell_fill(color = header_color)),
      locations = list(
        cells_stubhead(),
        cells_column_labels(columns = c(CM_Display, all_of(metric_cols_tbl))),
        cells_column_spanners()
      )
    )

  #-- RCM/CM stub columns (row-group label + CM_Display column) -> stub_color, black bold
  #text, applied to every data row (Sub-total/Total rows are re-styled below).
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = stub_color), cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "bold", color = "black", v_align = "middle", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = stub_color), cell_text(font = "IDLC", weight = "bold", color = "black", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_body(columns = CM_Display)
    )

  #-- Metric body cells, coloured by role (green = planned, orange = actual, blue = achievement)
  for (s in spanner_defs) {
    band_color <- role_colors[[s$role]]

    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_fill(color = band_color), cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", size = px(13))),
        locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(s$columns))
      )
  }

  #-- Sub-total rows: entire row (CM column + every metric column) -> stub_color, black
  #bold text, so the row reads as one flat band rather than the green/orange/blue mix
  #from the per-role styling above.
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = stub_color), cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(CM_Display, all_of(metric_cols_tbl)), rows = subtotal_rows)
    )

  #-- Grand Total row (last row): entire row, including its RCM row-group cell -> total_color,
  #bold WHITE text.
  gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = total_color), cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_body(columns = c(CM_Display, all_of(metric_cols_tbl)), rows = total_rows)
    ) |>
    #-- the grand "Total" row is its own single-row group (RCM_Display == "Total"), so
    #its RCM group-column cell can be targeted directly by group name; per-RCM Sub-total
    #rows share their group with sibling CM rows and so keep the group column's normal
    #stub_color, since gt's cells_row_groups() only targets by group name, not by row.
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = total_color), cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold", size = px(13))),
      locations = cells_row_groups(groups = "Total")
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), color = "gray", weight = px(1)),
      locations = list(cells_body(), cells_stub(), cells_row_groups())
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = c("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), color = "black", weight = px(1.5)),
      locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_stubhead(), cells_column_spanners())
    )

  gt_tbl
}

yesterday_projection_gt <- build_cm_projection_gt(
  rcm_cm_dashboard_df, yday_cm_spanner_defs,
  role_colors = yday_role_colors, stub_color = yday_stub_color,
  header_color = yday_header_color, total_color = yday_total_color, table_width = pct(95)
)

yesterday_projection_gt
```

```{r}

#Excel workbook -- Dashboard (RCM-wise, with merged RCM column and Sub-total/Total rows)
#+ lead-level detail sheets, openxlsx2 style
#NOTE: the Excel Dashboard sheet is unchanged (still RCM/Branch-wise) -- only the RMD
#output's "Yesterday's Projection" table above was switched to RCM/CM-wise with
#Achievement columns, per requirements. yesterday_record (used to read back "planned"
#figures for tomorrow's run) still parses this same RCM/Branch layout, so it is left as-is.

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

#-- Helper: add a detail sheet; if the data frame has no rows, write just the column headers
add_detail_sheet <- function(wb, sheet, df) {
  wb$add_worksheet(sheet)
  if (nrow(df) > 0) {
    wb$add_data(sheet = sheet, x = df)
  } else {
    wb$add_data(sheet = sheet, x = as.data.frame(t(names(df))), col_names = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(wb)
}

wb <- wb_workbook()

wb$add_worksheet("Dashboard", grid_lines = FALSE, zoom = 90)

#-- Header: RCM | Branch | Today's Projection (3 spanners x 2 cols) | Yesterday's Projection (6 spanners x 2 cols)
wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = "RCM",    start_row = 1, start_col = 1, col_names = FALSE)
wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = "Branch", start_row = 1, start_col = 2, col_names = FALSE)
wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = "Today's Projection",     start_row = 1, start_col = 3, col_names = FALSE)
wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = "Yesterday's Projection", start_row = 1, start_col = 9, col_names = FALSE)
wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = "A1:A3")
wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = "B1:B3")
wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = "C1:H1")
wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = "I1:T1")

spanner_labels     <- c("To Be Visited", "Pending To Be Declared", "Decision To Be Made",
                         "To Be Visited", "Visited", "Pending To Be Declared", "Pending Declared",
                         "Decision To Be Made", "Decision Finalized")
spanner_start_cols <- seq(3, 19, by = 2)

for (i in seq_along(spanner_labels)) {
  scol <- spanner_start_cols[i]
  wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = spanner_labels[i], start_row = 2, start_col = scol, col_names = FALSE)
  wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 2, cols = scol:(scol + 1)))
}

wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = as.data.frame(t(rep(c("Number", "Amount(Mln)"), 9))),
            start_row = 3, start_col = 3, col_names = FALSE)

#-- Body
dashboard_body <- rcm_dashboard_df |> select(RCM_Display, Branch, all_of(metric_cols))
dashboard_body$RCM_Display[is.na(dashboard_body$RCM_Display)] <- ""

first_data_row <- 4
wb$add_data(sheet = "Dashboard", x = dashboard_body, start_row = first_data_row, col_names = FALSE)

last_row <- first_data_row + nrow(dashboard_body) - 1

#-- Merge the RCM column down each RCM's branch rows (Sub-total / Total rows excluded)
branch_idx <- which(rcm_dashboard_df$Row_Type == "Branch")
run_group  <- rle(rcm_dashboard_df$Group[branch_idx])
pos <- 1
for (k in seq_along(run_group$lengths)) {
  len <- run_group$lengths[k]
  excel_rows <- branch_idx[pos:(pos + len - 1)] + first_data_row - 1
  if (len > 1) {
    wb$merge_cells(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = min(excel_rows):max(excel_rows), cols = 1))
  }
  pos <- pos + len
}

#-- Colours: RCM / Branch / Today's Projection header block = #ee3e11, Yesterday's = #1ecbe1
wb$add_fill(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 1:3, cols = 1:8),  color = wb_color("#ee3e11"))
wb$add_fill(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 1:3, cols = 9:20), color = wb_color("#1ecbe1"))
wb$add_font(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 1:3, cols = 1:20), color = wb_color("#FFFFFF"),
            bold = TRUE, name = "Cambria", size = 10)

subtotal_excel_rows <- which(rcm_dashboard_df$Row_Type == "Subtotal") + first_data_row - 1
total_excel_rows    <- which(rcm_dashboard_df$Row_Type == "Total")    + first_data_row - 1

#wb_dims() only accepts contiguous row ranges, and Sub-total rows are scattered between
#RCM groups, so each row is styled individually here rather than in one wb_dims() call.
for (r in subtotal_excel_rows) {
  wb$add_fill(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = r, cols = 1:20), color = wb_color("#E0E0E0"))
  wb$add_font(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = r, cols = 1:20), bold = TRUE, name = "Cambria", size = 10)
}

for (r in total_excel_rows) {
  wb$add_fill(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = r, cols = 1:20), color = wb_color("#CCCCCC"))
  wb$add_font(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = r, cols = 1:20), bold = TRUE, name = "Cambria", size = 10)
}

wb$add_border(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 1:last_row, cols = 1:20), bottom_border = "thin",
              left_border = "thin",
              right_border = "thin",
              top_border = "thin",
              inner_hgrid = "thin",
              inner_vgrid = "thin")
wb$add_font(sheet = "Dashboard", dims = wb_dims(rows = 4:last_row, cols = 1:20), name = "Cambria", size = 10)
wb$set_col_widths(sheet = "Dashboard", cols = 1:20, widths = "auto")

#-- Detail sheets (empty data frames get a header row only)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "To Be Visited",                  to_be_visited_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Pending To Be Declared",         pending_to_be_declared_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Decision To Be Made",            decision_to_be_made_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Delayed Processing",             delayed_processing_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Pending Declared Not Collected", pending_declared_not_collected_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Sanctioned",                     sanctioned_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Rejected",                       rejected_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Insufficient Docs & Del. Nego.", insufficient_detail)
add_detail_sheet(wb, "Waiting for Prospect Creation",  waiting_for_lead_creation_detail)

wb$save(output_file, overwrite = TRUE)

dbDisconnect(con)

message(paste0("Saved workbook to ", output_file))

```
